newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's May budget deficit down 30.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's May budget deficit down 30.3 pct.

text.p: Spain's May budget deficit was 513.2 billion pesetas on a cash basis, down 30.3 percent from the year-ago month, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said.

"According to provisional figures -- final data will be available between June 15 and June 20 -- in May we had a deficit on a cash basis of 513.2 billion pesetas, down 30.3 pct over May 1996," Folgado told journalists.
In the first five months on a cash basis, Folgado said the budget deficit was down 10.9 percent, but he gave no specific figures, a spokesman for the Economy Ministry said.
